protocol.model: StandardScaler + Ridge(alpha=1.0), log target / exp inverse
protocol.selection_clarification: Both policies are compared only on development. Only the chosen policy and both baselines enter final test. Clarified before any model evaluation.
protocol.data_access_disclosure: Periods were declared before CSV values or any model errors were inspected. Subsequent official release research incidentally displayed some 2023-2025 actual index levels. No final-test model results informed this protocol.
protocol.release_lag: One observation step, not a publication-date simulation. TSI data for a month are normally released in the second following calendar month.
protocol.vintage_limit: Latest-vintage historical levels may depend on later source revisions and seasonal adjustment. Causal code cannot remove that retrospective information.
protocol.final_policy_fit: Refit through development end before final test. Fixed freezes estimator coefficients but updates observed lag features. Monthly_refit refits after each observed month.

limitations: Historical revisions and seasonal adjustment may use later information.
Observation month is not publication time. Release lag is not simulated.
National index points are not shipment counts or household goods demand.
No serving model is replaced. Baseline losses remain valid results.

data.name: BTS Freight Transportation Services Index
data.publisher: U.S. Department of Transportation, Bureau of Transportation Statistics
data.rights_note: The official dataset identifies US government work. Attribute BTS. This is the aggregate index, not redistribution of proprietary modal inputs or agency logos.
data.transformations: Official API projects obs_date and tsi_freight and sorts by obs_date. Saved response bytes are unchanged. All 319 date/value pairs equal the full official CSV export. Evaluation renames columns internally and excludes 2026.
